src/solid.reason: Upstream uses the checked-in src/vendor/solid builds by default.

checkout: Pinned Telegram Web K source imported onto a separate branch of the existing Monolith repository; original main history is preserved. Obsolete prebuilt public bundles are omitted. In Arena, unchanged public upstream binary blobs may be fetched lazily from the public upstream remote.
clientPatches: src/components/countryInputField.ts: safely ignore nearest-DC countries missing from the phone-country list.
vite.monolith.config.ts and scripts/monolith-pages.mjs: GitHub Pages project paths, test-build identity, scoped PWA manifests and GPL/source links; Telegram protocol unchanged.
scripts/monolith-api-config.mjs and Pages workflow: validate build-time app configuration without printing values, mark own-API provenance and deploy via least-privilege Actions.
notes: Stage 0 public test baseline only. No Monolith RPC interception, anti-recall, ghost mode, user session, production push relay or hosted backend has been implemented. GitHub Pages hosts static client files only. Upstream CI is retained as inactive documentation templates.
